review_type: Scope-preservation preflight for alternate initial camp deployment

original_D06_requirement.name: Connected camp study
original_D06_requirement.views: Compact perimeter routing with storage, production, customer counter, centered heater and two clear gates; no external painted roads.

decision: An explicit initial serial storage-buffered deployment is a valid alternative D06 representative installation. The original requirement does not demand all direct/overflow or 25 catalogue routes in one overview. Full direct/overflow topology remains covered by the unchanged approved D02 and D07 artifacts.
required_initial_route_coverage: Cooker cooked OUT -> prepared-food storage IN through finite holding/reserved receiving
Requested prepared-food storage OUT -> accepted counter buffer
Manual stock-buffer -> customer-table handoff; cash separate
Utility and fuel/manual zones remain separate
conditions: Label D06 and its gallery/README description as proposed initial serial storage-buffered deployment. Identify D07 as the fuller direct/overflow upgrade, not an exact layout match to the initial camp.

Add a small typed initial-deployment route record with item forms, source/destination ports, one-way direction, proposal status and stop/reservation rules. Preserve D07 bytes and all rejected full-route camp attempts.
Retain finite storage, finite customer stock, request-controlled OUT and output-space reservation. Full storage or counter propagates wait; no automatic OUT->IN path, duplication or deletion.

A 180-degree house rotation rotates its original door, utility, food and fuel faces together. Both rear food sleeves may face the camera, while a visibly connected service aisle must reach the original front-door side behind the house. Physical local left/right are not globally relabelled.
Retain the canonical counter and staff/customer/cash separation, centered heater, two clear bidirectional gate approaches, source style and actual supported transfers.
All prior mandatory checks still apply to the total package. A simpler valid representative deployment does not excuse wrong ports, missing transfers or inaccessible service faces.

R01_R13_coverage_reasoning.R03_R04: All requested route families remain explicitly represented across D04, D04B, D06 and D07; the new initial-route record makes its distinct topology reviewable.
R01_R13_coverage_reasoning.R05_R09: Single-source counter restock needs no two-source merge in this mode; material separation, finite receiving, reservations and no recirculation remain mandatory. The full merge behavior is still illustrated and specified in D02/D07.
R01_R13_coverage_reasoning.R06_R07_R10_R11_R12: Storage architecture/manual zones, counter identity, clear service paths/gates, heater and visual family stay mandatory under rotation.
R01_R13_coverage_reasoning.R01_R02_R08_R13: Evidence honesty, physical transfer review and actual independent output inspection are unchanged.

approval_boundary: Preflight only. No approval of a future camp image or new route record before their actual content is inspected; R14 publication remains separate.
